boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten distinct Lake Shore Campus places for studying, gathering, recreation, reflection, and campus events.

cards.title: Set up a group-study session at the Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 6501 N. Kenmore Ave.
cards.notes: Use the technology-friendly collaborative spaces for group work, then reserve a study space when your project needs a dedicated room.
cards.short_summary: A lakefront library-and-technology space for collaborative work, reading, and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes the Information Commons as offering group-study space, technology, and areas for work, reading, and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and use its study-space reservation link for reservable rooms.

cards.title: Browse Cudahy Library beyond the group tables
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 1032 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Start with the humanities, social sciences, science, or fine-arts collections, and ask library staff when you need help locating material.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s main library holds broad academic collections, archives, and government documents.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Cudahy Library as its main library, housing fine arts, humanities, social sciences, science, archives, and government documents.
cards.source_title: Library Locations & Maps | Loyola University Chicago Libraries
cards.access_notes: Loyola Archives says entry to Cudahy Library is through the Information Commons; check library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Meet at Damen before an organization program
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 6511 N. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Use the atrium and meeting areas as a practical rendezvous point, then stop by the Center for Student Engagement for involvement questions.
cards.short_summary: The student-life hub combines dining, recreation, a cinema, and organization meeting areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola calls Damen its primary hub for student-life engagement and describes dining, recreation, cinema, and meeting areas there.
cards.access_notes: Academic-calendar building hours are published by Damen; some offices and programs have separate hours.

cards.title: Look for a program in Mundelein’s Palm Court or Sky Lounge
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 1020 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Check the campus scheduling system for what is happening in named Mundelein rooms before heading over for a performance or gathering.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus building with named gathering spaces including Palm Court and Sky Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s campus-reservations page lists Mundelein Center spaces including Palm Court, Sky Lounge, Greenhouse, and Jo Ann Rooney Hall.
cards.access_notes: Room use depends on the academic schedule and reservations; review 25Live details for current availability.

cards.title: Hear the Stamm Memorial Organ at Madonna della Strada
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 1032 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Consult the chapel’s concert listing for the monthly organ series, or visit during an announced university liturgy or reflection time.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s Art Deco main chapel also hosts a monthly organ concert series.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Madonna della Strada as the main university chapel and lists a third-Sunday monthly organ concert series there.
cards.source_title: Stamm Memorial Organ | Loyola University Chicago
cards.access_notes: Concert dates are published by the chapel; attendance and building access can vary with services and university events.

cards.title: Build a recreation break around Halas
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 6458 N. Winthrop Ave.
cards.notes: Choose a campus-recreation activity that fits your schedule, from the track and courts to swimming, group fitness, or the rock wall.
cards.short_summary: A recreation facility with fitness equipment, pool, courts, track, and group-fitness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists a pool, courts, walking/running track, fitness equipment, and group-fitness classes at Halas Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Halas Recreation Center | Loyola University Chicago
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation can change schedules or close areas for events; verify current hours, membership eligibility, and activity schedules.

cards.title: Join an outdoor intramural session at Sean Earl Field
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Check Campus Recreation’s intramural schedule, then use the turf field as the designated on-campus setting for outdoor sport activities.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s campus turf field is the home site for outdoor intramural sports.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola states that Sean Earl Field is the campus turf field and hosts its outdoor intramural sports.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Loyola University Chicago Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Use is tied to Campus Recreation programming and field schedules; confirm availability before planning play.

cards.title: Watch the campus calendar for Gentile Arena gatherings
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Check the official events calendar for ceremonies and other announced programs, and arrive only when the event’s entry details are published.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Shore Campus arena used for major university ceremonies and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s events calendar lists Commencement, University Convocation, and New Student Convocation at Gentile Arena.
cards.access_notes: Arena access is event-specific; follow the entry, ticketing, and accessibility instructions for the program you attend.

cards.title: Spot the Ecodome within Loyola’s sustainability complex
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 6349 N. Kenmore Ave.
cards.notes: Use the building as a starting point for learning about campus sustainability, then look for public programs or classes that explain its systems.
cards.short_summary: A three-story agricultural greenhouse element within Loyola’s sustainability facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes the Institute of Environmental Sustainability as including an urban agricultural greenhouse and a 3,100-square-foot Ecodome.
cards.source_title: Institute of Environmental Sustainability | Loyola University Chicago
cards.access_notes: The facility contains classrooms and research areas; attend only publicly announced programming or follow building-access guidance.

cards.title: Recognize Cudahy Science Hall’s green dome
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · 1032 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Pause outside to identify the green dome, then connect its landmark exterior with the teaching laboratories and science work inside.
cards.short_summary: An early Lake Shore Campus landmark with modern physics teaching and research spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes Cudahy Science Hall as a campus landmark with a green dome and physics teaching laboratories.
cards.source_title: Cudahy Science Hall | Loyola University Chicago
cards.access_notes: Teaching laboratories are academic spaces; observe building-access guidance and do not enter restricted lab areas.
